patch_description: This keeps the existing direct-link rewards, relay budget, pressure adjustment, congestion terms, normalization, and degree penalty unchanged. The relay allocation now considers both legs of each candidate two-hop path: `min(a, b) + 0.25 * max(a, b) + 0.01`. The minimum-leg term favors paths whose two legs are both useful, while the modest stronger-leg contribution gives some credit to paths with one especially promising leg. Pressure still reduces the attractiveness of heavily loaded relay nodes.
